title: Polarity IHC of Drosophila CNS
author: Geoffrey W. Meissner
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qf6dtre
materials: Reference primary antibodies. Remove block and add primary antibody diluted in 5% GS in PBT for a volume of 200 µL per tube. Incubate for 4 hours at RT on a rotator with tubes upright. Then continue incubation at 4°C on a rotator with tubes upright for 2 overnights. Mouse nc82 (1:30 or 33.3 µL/mL)

Neuron primary antibodies. Remove block and add primary antibodies diluted in 5% GS in PBT for a volume of 200 µL per tube. Incubate for 4 hours at RT on a rotator with tubes upright. Then continue incubation at 4°C on a rotator with tubes upright for 2 overnights. Rat α-FLAG Tag (1:100 or 10 µL/mL) Rabbit α-HA Tag (1:600 or 1.67 µL/mL)

Neuron secondary antibodies. Remove the PBT and add the secondary antibodies diluted in 5% GS in PBT for a volume of 200 µL per tube. Incubate for 4 hours at RT on a rotator with tubes upright. Then continue incubation at 4°C on a rotator with tubes upright for 2-3 overnights. ATTO647N Goat α-Rat (1:150 or 6.6 µL/mL) Cy3 Goat α-Rabbit (1:1000 or 1 µL/mL)

Post-secondary washes. Remove the secondary antibodies and do a brief rinse with 1.75 mL 0.5% PBT. Allow the tissue to settle to the bottom and then remove the rinse solution and add 1.75 mL 0.5% PBT. Wash for a total of 3 X 30-minute washes while nutating (or 4 x 15 minutes). If needed, store tissue in 0.5% PBT at 4°C while nutating or lay tube flat and rotate.

steps.title: Dissect CNS
steps.instruction: Dissect adult brains or CNS in cold Schneider’s Insect Medium (S2).

steps.title: Initial Fixation
steps.instruction: Transfer tissue to 2 mL Protein LoBind tubes filled with 2% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in S2.

substeps.instruction: Fix for 55 minutes at RT while nutating.

steps.title: Post-Fix Wash
steps.instruction: Remove fixative and wash tissue with 1.75 mL phosphate buffered saline with 0.5% Triton X-100 (PBT).

substeps.instruction: Perform a total of 4 X 10-minute washes while nutating.
Optional: Store tissue in 0.5% PBT at 4°C while nutating or lay tube flat and rotate.

steps.title: First Blocking
steps.instruction: Remove PBT and add 200 µL 5% Goat Serum (GS) in PBT per tube.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 1.5 hours at RT on a rotator with tubes upright.

steps.title: Reference Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Remove PBT and add the reference primary antibody (Cy2 Goat α-Mouse, 1:600 or 1.67 µL/mL) diluted in 5% GS in PBT (200 µL per tube).

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 4 hours at RT on a rotator with tubes upright.
Continue incubation at 4°C on a rotator with tubes upright for 2-3 overnights.

steps.title: Post-Reference Primary Washes
steps.instruction: Remove the primary antibody and perform a brief rinse with 1.75 mL 0.5% PBT.

substeps.instruction: Allow tissue to settle, remove rinse, and add 1.75 mL 0.5% PBT.
Wash for a total of 3 X 30-minute washes (or 4 X 15 minutes) while nutating.

steps.title: Second Fixation
steps.instruction: Transfer tissue to 2 mL Protein LoBind tubes filled with 2% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS at RT.

substeps.instruction: Fix for 55 minutes at RT while nutating.

steps.title: Second Post-Fix Wash
steps.instruction: Remove fixative and wash tissue with 1.75 mL phosphate buffered saline with 0.5% Triton X-100 (PBT).

substeps.instruction: Perform a total of 4 X 10-minute washes while nutating.
Optional: Store tissue in 0.5% PBT at 4°C while nutating or lay tube flat and rotate.

steps.title: Second Blocking
steps.instruction: Remove PBT and add 200 µL of 5% GS in PBT per tube.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 1.5 hours at RT on a rotator with tubes upright.

steps.title: Post-Neuron Primary Washes
steps.instruction: Remove the neuron primary antibodies and perform a brief rinse with 1.75 mL 0.5% PBT.

substeps.instruction: Allow tissue to settle, remove rinse, and add 1.75 mL 0.5% PBT.
Wash for a total of 3 X 30-minute washes (or 4 X 15 minutes) while nutating.

steps.title: Pre-embedding Fixation
steps.instruction: Remove PBT and add 1.75 mL 4% PFA in PBS at RT.

substeps.instruction: Fix for 4 hours at RT while nutating.

steps.title: Post-4% PFA Washes
steps.instruction: Remove 4% PFA and perform a brief rinse with 1.75 mL 0.5% PBT.

substeps.instruction: Allow tissue to settle, remove rinse, and add 1.75 mL 0.5% PBT.
Wash for a total of 4 X 15-minute washes while nutating.
Optional: Store tissue in 0.5% PBT at 4°C while nutating or lay tube flat and rotate.

steps.title: Mounting
steps.instruction: Mount the tissue on a poly-L-lysine (PLL) coated cover glass.

steps.title: Dehydration
steps.instruction: Move the cover glass through a series of 7 cover glass staining jars with increasing ethanol concentrations.

substeps.instruction: Soak the cover glass for 10 minutes in each jar.

steps.title: Xylene Clearing
steps.instruction: In the hood, move the cover glass through a series of 3 jars filled with xylene.

substeps.instruction: Soak the cover glass for 5 minutes in each jar.

steps.title: DPX Embedding
steps.instruction: Add 7 drops of dibutyl phthalate in xylene (DPX) on top of the tissue mounted on the cover glass.

substeps.instruction: Place the cover glass (DPX down) on a prepared slide with spacers.
Use the edge of a glass slide to gently press down on the center of the cover glass to seat it onto the slide.
Let the slide dry in the hood for 2 days before viewing.
